_about: Norms transcribed from primary sources by the research agents (2026-10-31). See research/sources.md. Cox 2006 tables could not be obtained (paywalled) - not included.

elvin2016.citation: Elvin, Williams & Escudero (2016) JASA 140(1):576-581, Table I 'Ave' (mean of medians over 20-80% of vowel; all 6 consonant frames, not hVd only; no SDs). Western Sydney, 12 F / 7 M, 18-30 y. Values via HTML table extraction - verify against PDF.

butcher2006.citation: Butcher (2006) Proc. 11th SST, pp. 449-453, Table 1: 92 young South Australian females, hVd, 3 tokens, LPC at steady-state centre. F1/F2 means only.

hillenbrand_clark2009.citation: Hillenbrand & Clark (2009) Atten Percept Psychophys 71(5):1150-1166, p.1151: women/men formant ratios 1.18, 1.17, 1.14 (F1, F2, F3; American English, Hillenbrand et al. 1995); envelope shift used x1.168, f0 x1.7041 (p.1154).
